card.name: Slot before an impressive verb or adjective
card.fires_on: Words in descriptive or promotional prose where the next word is likely a vivid, dramatic verb or adjective (amazing, tirelessly, astonishing, ruined). The marked word is often a subject, verb, or small linking word.

modes.label: Subject or verb before a vivid word
modes.description: A noun or verb in an admiring description, right before a striking verb or adverb.
modes.example: Starlings<< create>> these amazing patterns when flying together.

modes.label: Small word before an evaluative adjective
modes.description: A determiner or adverb just ahead of a strong descriptive word.
modes.example: an<< absolutely>> astonishing hymn to how great it would

modes.label: Nouns in a damage or discovery list
modes.description: A noun in a dramatic scene, followed by a result word.
modes.example: they emerged to find<< roads>> and property ruined by wind and coastal flooding

card.writes: It pushes toward grand words like revolutionary, visionary and perfected, and away from mild praise like nice or very good.
card.plain: It fires in lively, promotional writing just before a bold, dramatic word is expected, not a mild one like nice.
